cover.title: The UK's age-verification regime moves from rules to enforcement as Ofcom investigates Pornhub
cover.summary: Ofcom has opened an investigation into Pornhub over concerns that UK children can still access it despite the Online Safety Act's age-check requirements. cover.title: The UK's age-verification regime moves from rules to enforcement as Ofcom investigates Pornhub
cover.summary: Ofcom has opened an investigation into Pornhub over concerns that UK children can still access it despite the Online Safety Act's age-check requirements. This marks a decisive shift from passing legislation to proving compliance, setting a precedent for how far online-safety rules can constrain major adult platforms.

question.lead: The test of platform age-gating has shifted from passing legislation to proving compliance.
question.title: Will enforcement, not legislation, determine the effectiveness of online age verification?
question.footnote: The Online Safety Act's age-verification provisions have been law since 2023, but this is the first major investigation of a global adult platform under its enforcement regime.
